title: Any morphism from the spectrum of an Artinian ring to a quasi-separated algebraic space is affine
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-separated algebraic space X over S and an Artinian ring A, every morphism Spec(A) -> X is affine (source lines 4147-4151). The proof uses the local criterion for affineness, reducing to showing that Spec(A) x_X U is affine for every affine scheme U etale over X. Quasi-separatedness of X makes that fibre product quasi-compact, its projection to Spec(A) is etale, hence has finite discrete fibres, and the topology on Spec(A) of an Artinian ring is discrete; so the fibre product is a scheme whose underlying space is a finite discrete set, and a scheme with finite discrete underlying space is affine.
